rationale: The evidence shows the Teleport user eve.contractor@eproc.test queried sensitive vendors.bank_account data and performed a bulk export of 12,000 rows from the payments table via COPY TO STDOUT. This activity occurred outside their normal 08:00-17:00 active hours and significantly exceeded their typical 3,947 daily rows read. I am targeting the individual Teleport user with a lock to prevent further data exfiltration. This scope is correct because disabling the shared analyst_ro database role would inappropriately disrupt other users.
rollback: IRREVERSIBLE: The tctl lock command creates a lock with a dynamically generated UUID. It must be manually identified using 'tctl get locks' and removed using 'tctl rm lock/<lock-name>'.

alert_summary.rule_name: Bulk export via COPY TO STDOUT

evidence.statement: SELECT payment_id, invoice_no, amount, bank_account_snapshot FROM payments
SELECT p.payment_id, p.bank_account_snapshot, v.legal_name, v.bank_account FROM payments p JOIN contracts c USING (contract_id) JOIN vendors v USING (vendor_id)
COPY (SELECT payment_id, invoice_no, amount, bank_account_snapshot FROM payments) TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER
